name: Belknap Range Trail (Mack to Major)
description: The eastern Belknap Range Trail corridor linking Mt. Mack over Anna and Straightback to Mt. Major. A ridge-link segment, not the full 12-summit day (see Belknap 12 - Full Traverse).

name: Belknap 12 - Full Traverse
description: Single-day traverse of all 12 Belknap summits (Rowe, Gunstock, Belknap, Piper, Whiteface, Klem, Mack, Rand, West Quarry, Anna, Straightback, Major): ~18 mi and ~4,875 ft gain, point-to-point with a shuttle between Mt Major and Mt Rowe. The AMC Belknap 12 patch objective. NOTE: route is a best-effort stitch of existing trails - the Belknap-to-Piper connector and the Rand/West Quarry stretch (on the Belknap Range Trail corridor) need field verification against a GPX track.
highlights: All 12 Belknap summits in a day
Point-to-point (shuttle between Mt Major and Mt Rowe)
